title: Drawn Deep Manga Ends
content: Sūji Hanabusa announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on July 5 that the Drawn Deep ( Ayashi Michizure ) manga ended with the 13th chapter, which launched on online platforms on the same day. Hanabusa shared an illustration commemorating the release.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Summer 2026 Action Shonen Is Proving to Be the Ultimate Jujutsu Kaisen Replacement
content: The Summer 2026 anime season is heating up, and Crunchyroll continues to roll out new episodes from its stacked lineup. So far, it has easily been the strongest season of the year, with wave after wave of new anime standing out.
author: ComicBook

title: We Are Aliens Anime Film Screens at Film Festivals in Canada, Australia, New Zealand in 2026
content: MIFF and NZIFF will also screen Kiyoshi Kurosawa 's live-action film adaptation of Honobu Yonezawa 's The Samurai and the Prisoner ( Kokurōjō ) samurai historical mystery novel.
author: ANN

title: 60 Years Later, A Classic Superhero Shonen Is Finally Getting an English Release
content: The anime and manga industry has been actively offering new kinds of stories for fans over several decades. While the medium only became popular across the globe during the 1990s and 2000s, Japan has been releasing new series for several decades.
author: ComicBook

title: King of the Hill Showrunner Explains Why Luanne Is Still Missing From Revival (Exclusive)
content: King of the Hill now has two seasons of the revival under its belt with only a single reference to Luanne , and the showrunner behind the new era of the series explained to ComicBook why she and Lucky are still absent from the series.
author: ComicBook

title: Hasbro Legends Linear Channel Launches with Transformers, Power Rangers, Duel Masters
content: Hasbro Entertainment and multi-platform broadcast company Get After It Media (GAIM) officially launched Hasbro Legends , a new linear channel featuring Hasbro properties, on July 13. The channel airs programming across GAIM's broadcast network as well as on streaming platforms including Heartland+ and Plex .
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Coolest Action Anime Could Get Big Update Soon as Fans Wait on New Season
content: One of the coolest action anime franchises that you can now find streaming with Crunchyroll could be sharing a big update very soon as fans are waiting on the anime to return with a new season.
author: ComicBook

title: Sweetness & Lightning Creator Gido Amagakure's Yurayura Q Comedy Manga Gets TV Anime
content: A website opened on Monday to announce that a television anime adaptation of Gido Amagakure 's Yurayura Q manga has been green-lit. Amagakure launched the manga in Hakusensha 's The Hana to Yume Fantasy magazine in October 2019, and will end the manga on July 27.
author: ANN

title: Anime NYC Screens World Premiere of Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! Anime
content: Crunchyroll announced on Monday that it will screen the world premiere for the first two episodes of the television anime of Haka Tokura 's Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! light novel series at this year's Anime NYC event on August 22.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Confirms Return Date to End Shonen Jump Hiatus
content: Kagurabachi has been on a hiatus from the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine this Summer, but it has finally confirmed a date for when it’s coming back for new chapters.
author: ComicBook
